headline: CVS Health plans drugstore business spinoff; shares plunge
summary: CVS announced plans to spin off its drugstore network into a new listed company, arguing the two businesses will operate better separately. The market reacted negatively, sending shares down 12%.
why: CVS Health is a major US healthcare and retail pharmacy conglomerate operating extensive drugstore and pharmacy benefit management operations.

impacts.name: CVS Health
impacts.why: The market reacted negatively to the planned drugstore spinoff announcement, driving down the company's shares by 12%.
